issues.description: Constructor parameter mismatch for GroverLightsOutPuzzle: the template declares __init__(self, initial_state: list[int]) while the solution implementation defines __init__(self) with no parameter. The problem statement's exercise tasks and later state_preparation signature expect the initial board state to be provided to state_preparation (state_of_lights), not to the constructor. This mismatch can confuse students about where to supply the initial puzzle state and how to instantiate the class.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor signatures consistent. Either remove the initial_state parameter from the template constructor (so both template and solution use __init__(self) and accept the board via state_preparation), or update the solution to accept initial_state in its constructor and document that choice clearly in the problem statement. Preferably align with the problem text and state_preparation API by removing the constructor parameter from the template so students pass the initial board to state_preparation.
